themes: Each person carries their own deeds
summary_for_children: An-Najm means The Star. It begins by swearing by a star and teaches that the Prophet (peace be upon him) speaks only revelation, that each person is responsible for their own deeds, and that Allah is the Lord of Sirius.
environment_concept: A night sky with a setting star, then a land where laughter and tears, life and death, and the star Sirius are all named as from Allah.
architecture_and_scenery: Dark desert sky, a bright star setting, Sirius rising.

areas.name: Laughter and Tears
areas.description: A valley of sudden sunshine and soft rain, standing for joy and tears; no faces are shown.

activities.name: Find Sirius
activities.description: Find Sirius in the night sky.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Own deeds
activities.description: Fill your own basket with good deeds (adaptation).
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: Narration reverent; the Prophet's (peace be upon him) experience is not depicted.

status.playable_environment: not built: a shared symbolic setting stands in

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.
